blocks.prompt:
1 What are carbohydrates? Describe monosaccharides: their general formula, classification by number of carbon atoms and by functional group, and their open-chain and ring forms. (4 marks)
(Carbohydrates kya hain? Monosaccharides bayan karein: general formula, carbon atoms aur functional group ke lehaaz se darja bandi, aur open-chain aur ring shaklein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carbohydrates: qudrati organic compounds (sugars, starch, cellulose, bacteria ki cell walls aur insects ke exoskeletons ke substances), hamari khurak mein energy ka bara zariya. Chemical tor par yeh polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones ya un se bane compounds hain.

Monosaccharides: sab se saade carbohydrates (sugars); mazeed hydrolyse nahi hote. General formula Cₙ(H₂O)y, n = 3 se 7. Misaalein: glucose aur fructose.

Carbon atoms ke lehaaz se: 3 C triose, 4 C tetrose, 5 C pentose, 6 C hexose, waghera.
Functional group ke lehaaz se: aldose mein aldehydic group (glucose); ketose mein ketonic group (fructose).

Open-chain aur ring shaklein: monosaccharides open chain ya ring ki shakal mein hote hain aur dono aik doosre mein badal sakti hain. Pentoses aur hexoses ring shakal mein ziyada mustahkam aur ziyada hain. Fructose paanch members wala ring (furanose), glucose chhe members wala ring (pyranose) banata hai. Solution mein bhi ziyada molecules ring hain jo bohat thodi open-chain shakal ke saath equilibrium mein hain.

book_ref.quote: Chemically, they are polyhydroxy aldehydes or ketones or their derived compounds.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein monosaccharide ki misaal 'sucrose' aur 'solution mein linear' likha hai; dono book corrections hain: sucrose disaccharide hai aur solution mein bhi ziyada tar ring hi hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain how hydrogen bonding accounts for the physical properties of monosaccharides. Why is honey thick? Name the natural sources of glucose and fructose. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke hydrogen bonding monosaccharides ki physical khasusiyaat ki wajah kaise hai. Shehad gaarha kyun hai? Glucose aur fructose ke qudrati zariye batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sugar molecules mein bohat se hydroxyl (–OH) groups hain.

Solid haalat: –OH groups molecules ke darmiyan ziyada hydrogen bonding karte hain, is liye khalis monosaccharides solid hain.
Hal hona: solution mein yeh paani ke molecules se ziyada hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye paani mein bohat hal hain.
Shehad: shehad mein glucose aur fructose ziyada hain; un ki mazboot hydrogen bonding shehad ko gaarha aur viscous banati hai.

Zariye aur istemal: glucose khoon mein hone ki wajah se blood sugar kehlati hai; fructose phalon aur shehad mein ziyada hai. Monosaccharides zinda organisms mein foran energy ka behtareen zariya hain.

book_ref.quote: The presence of many hydroxyl groups (–OH) in the sugar molecules

blocks.prompt:
3 What are disaccharides? Explain their formation by a condensation reaction with an equation, and describe the glycosidic bond using sucrose as an example. (4 marks)
(Disaccharides kya hain? Equation ke saath condensation reaction se un ka banna samjhayein, aur sucrose ki misaal se glycosidic bond bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Disaccharides: do monosaccharide units glycosidic linkage se jude hon, general formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁. Aam misaalein: sucrose, lactose aur maltose.

Banna (condensation): aik monosaccharide ka hydroxyl group doosre monosaccharide ke hydrogen se covalent bond ke zariye milta hai aur paani ka aik molecule nikalta hai:
C₆H₁₂O₆ + C₆H₁₂O₆ → C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ + H₂O

Glycosidic bond: dono units ko jodne wala C–O–C bond glycosidic bond kehlata hai.

Misaal: sucrose, aam cheeni, glucose aur fructose ka disaccharide hai jo glycosidic bond se jude hain:
glucose + fructose → sucrose + paani

book_ref.quote: The bond C–O–C is known as the glycosidic bond.

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is cellulose called a structural polysaccharide while starch and glycogen are storage polysaccharides? Explain with reference to their structures and where they are found. (4 marks)
(Cellulose ko structural polysaccharide aur starch aur glycogen ko storage polysaccharides kyun kehte hain? Un ki banawat aur maujoodgi ke hawale se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Teeno glucose units ke polysaccharides hain, general formula (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ.

Storage polysaccharides:
• Starch paudon ka bara energy zakheera hai (aalu, chuqandar, chawal, anaaj). Is ke do hisse hain: amylose (lambi be-shaakh chains, bohat glycosidic linkages) aur amylopectin (compact, bohat shaakhon wali banawat).
• Glycogen (animal starch) glucose ka polymer hai jo janwaron ke liver aur muscles mein jama hota hai. Is ki banawat amylopectin jaisi magar ziyada shaakhon wali hai. Zaaid glucose glycogen ban kar jama hota hai.

Structural polysaccharide:
• Cellulose paudon ki cell walls ka bara structural maadda hai aur pattiyon, shaakhon aur tane ka bara hissa hai. Is ke glucose units lambi be-shaakh chains banate hain jo glycosidic bonds se judi hain; yeh chains aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain, is liye cellulose sakht aur paani mein na-hal hai. Insani khurak mein yeh fibre hai jo aanton ki sehat behtar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Starch is the main storage of energy in plants

blocks.prompt:
5 A sample of starch, (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ, has molar mass 81 000 g mol⁻¹. (i) Find n. (ii) On complete hydrolysis each C₆H₁₀O₅ unit takes up one H₂O and gives one glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆. What mass of glucose is obtained from 81 g of this starch? (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16) (4 marks)
(Starch (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ ke aik namoone ka molar mass 81 000 g mol⁻¹ hai. (i) n maloom karein. (ii) Mukammal hydrolysis mein har C₆H₁₀O₅ unit aik H₂O le kar aik glucose C₆H₁₂O₆ deta hai. Is starch ke 81 g se kitna glucose milega? (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16))
blocks.explanation: Molar mass ko aik unit ke mass se taqseem karein; phir har mole unit se aik mole glucose milta hai.

book_ref.quote: Polysaccharides give simple sugars, i.e., monosaccharides on hydrolysis.

steps: Aik unit C₆H₁₀O₅ ka mass = 6(12) + 10(1) + 5(16) = 162 g mol⁻¹
(ii) 81 g mein units ke moles = 81 ÷ 162 = 0.50 mol, is liye glucose = 0.50 mol
C₆H₁₂O₆ ka molar mass = 72 + 12 + 96 = 180 g mol⁻¹; glucose ka mass = 0.50 × 180 = 90 g

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the nutritional importance of carbohydrates and the risks of imbalance in their intake. (4 marks)
(Carbohydrates ki ghizai ahmiyat aur un ke ghair-mutawazin istemal ke khatraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carbohydrates energy aur ghiza ke liye zaroori hain; un ki qisam aur miqdaar sehat par bara asar daalti hai.

Glucose (saadi sugars):
• Cells ke liye energy ka bunyaadi zariya; aasani se jazb aur metabolise hota hai, 1 g glucose taqreeban 15.6 kJ deta hai.
• Zaaid glucose liver aur muscles mein glycogen ban kar jama hota hai.
• Normal blood glucose 70-110 mg/dL hai, jise insulin aur glucagon hormones control karte hain.
• Normal had se oopar diabetes ho sakti hai, daaimi haalat jab pancreas kaafi insulin na banaye ya jism use theek istemal na kare. Be-qaabu diabetes hyperglycemia (ziyada blood sugar) paida karti hai jo waqt ke saath nerves aur blood vessels ko nuqsan deti hai.
• Kam carbohydrates thakawat aur jismani o zehni karkardagi mein kami laate hain.

Fructose aur refined sugars: fructose energy deta hai magar ziyada istemal motapa paida karta hai. Ziyada refined sugar wali khurak diabetes, dil ki bimari aur kuch cancers se judi hai; complex carbohydrates aur fibres hifazat karte hain.

Proteins aur fats ki bachat: kaafi carbohydrates hon to jism proteins ya fats todne ke bajaye inhi se energy leta hai.

book_ref.quote: Carbohydrates have a complex role in the human health.

blocks.prompt:
7 A person has a blood glucose level of 95 mg/dL and a blood volume of 5.0 dm³ (1 dm³ = 10 dL). (i) Is this level within the normal range? (ii) Calculate the mass of glucose in the blood. (iii) How much energy would this glucose provide, if 1 g gives about 15.6 kJ? (4 marks)
(Aik shakhs ka blood glucose 95 mg/dL aur khoon ka hajm 5.0 dm³ hai (1 dm³ = 10 dL). (i) Kya yeh normal range mein hai? (ii) Khoon mein glucose ka mass maloom karein. (iii) Agar 1 g taqreeban 15.6 kJ deta hai to yeh glucose kitni energy dega?)
blocks.explanation: 70-110 mg/dL se muqabla karein, khoon ka hajm dL mein badlein, concentration se zarb dein, phir 15.6 kJ fi gram istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: with 1 g of glucose providing about 15.6 kJ

steps: (i) Normal range 70-110 mg/dL hai; 95 mg/dL is ke andar hai
(ii) Khoon ka hajm = 5.0 dm³ × 10 dL dm⁻³ = 50 dL
Glucose ka mass = 95 mg dL⁻¹ × 50 dL = 4750 mg = 4.75 g
blocks.final_answer: (i) Haan, normal; (ii) 4.75 g glucose; (iii) taqreeban 74 kJ (74.1 kJ)

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the formation of a peptide bond and a polypeptide chain. Describe the primary structure of a protein and show, with the example of sickle cell anemia, why the amino acid sequence matters. (4 marks)
(Peptide bond aur polypeptide chain ka banna samjhayein. Protein ka primary structure bayan karein aur sickle cell anemia ki misaal se dikhayein ke amino acids ki tarteeb kyun ahem hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Proteins amino acids (taqreeban 20 qismen) ki seedhi chains hain jo peptide bonds se judi hain.

Peptide bond: amide bond jo aik amino acid ke –COO⁻ group ke saath wale amino acid ke –NH₃⁺ group se react karne par banta hai; baar baar hone se linear polymer banta hai.
Polypeptide chain: bohat se peptide linkages se bani amino acids ki lambi chain. Har protein ki khaas polypeptide chains us ki banawat aur kaam tay karti hain.

Primary structure: polypeptide chain mein peptide bonds se judi amino acids ki khaas seedhi tarteeb. Yahi tarteeb tay karti hai ke protein kaise 3-D shakal mein tah ho, jo us ka biological kaam tay karti hai. Albumin aur insulin apni theek tarteeb par munhasir hain.

Tarteeb ki ahmiyat: aik amino acid ki choti tabdeeli bhi banawat badal kar kaam bigaad sakti hai. Sickle cell anemia mein haemoglobin ke ghalat banne se normal red blood cells darranti jaisi ho jati hain; yeh naaliyan band kar ke khoon ka daura bigaadti hain.

book_ref.quote: Proteins are linear chains of amino acids that are linked together by peptide bonds.

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the secondary structure of proteins. Compare the α-helix with the β-pleated sheet and state the importance of these arrangements. (4 marks)
(Proteins ka secondary structure bayan karein. α-helix ka β-pleated sheet se muqabla karein aur in tarteebon ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Secondary structure tab banta hai jab polypeptide chain ke backbone atoms hydrogen bonds banayen aur baqaida patterns bante hain: α-helices aur β-pleated sheets. Yeh tarteeben istehkaam aur lachak deti hain aur protein ki poori 3-D shakal mein hissa daalti hain jo us ke biological kaam ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: The secondary structure of a protein arises when the backbone atoms form hydrogen bonds

rows: Hydrogen bonds aik hi chain ke saath
Hydrogen bonds saath wale strands ke darmiyan
Lipti hui, spiral banawat
Tah shuda, sheet jaisi banawat
Misaal: keratin
Misaal: silk fibroin

blocks.prompt:
10 Classify proteins on the basis of their overall shape. Describe fibrous and globular proteins with examples, and explain denaturing of proteins. (4 marks)
(Proteins ko un ki poori shakal ki bunyaad par darja bandi karein. Misaalon ke saath fibrous aur globular proteins bayan karein aur proteins ki denaturing samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tertiary ya quaternary structure banne ke baad proteins ko un ki poori shakal ke lehaaz se do badi qismon mein baanta jata hai.

Denaturing: globular proteins garmi aur pH ke liye hassas hain. Garam karne par anday ki safedi sakht ho jati hai kyun ke chains ke darmiyan hydrogen bonding toot jati aur chains khul jati hain; lemon juice se pH badalne par doodh ka casein jam jata hai. Isay proteins ki denaturing kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: These proteins consist of long, rod-like, or thread-like molecules

rows: Lambe, chhari ya dhaage jaise molecules
Poora molecule gol ya anday jaisa
Chains mutawazi, mazboot hydrogen ya disulphide bonds se fibres
Chains compact shakal mein tah
Aam tor par na-hal, mazboot aur mustahkam
Garmi aur pH ke liye ziyada hassas
Structural polymers: collagen, keratin, myosin
Kaam karne wale proteins: enzymes, hormones, nutrients; anday ki safedi

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the biological functions of proteins, giving an example of each kind. (4 marks)
(Proteins ke biological kaam bayan karein, har qisam ki misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Proteins ko un ke biological aur metabolic kaam ke lehaaz se baanta jata hai:

• Hormonal proteins: growth, development, metabolism aur reproduction jaisi activities control karte hain; misaal pancreas ka insulin khoon se glucose ko cells mein jane ko control karta hai.
• Storage proteins: ugte paudon ya janwaron ki ibtidai nashonuma ke liye ghiza; misaal ferritin iron jama karta hai.
• Structural proteins: vertebrate jism mein sab se ziyada; fibrous, shakal aur sahara dete hain; misaal baalon ka keratin, lothre ka fibrin, collagen; jild, ligaments, tendons aur haddiyon ka dhancha.
• Contractile proteins: actin aur myosin muscle ke patle aur mote filaments banate hain jo sukadne aur phailne ka kaam karte hain.
• Defensive proteins: infection se ladte hain; misaal antibodies khaas antigens se jud kar unhein khatam karte hain.
• Transport (carrier) proteins: molecules aur ions ko membranes ke aar paar le jate hain; misaal haemoglobin phephron aur tissues ke darmiyan oxygen le jata hai.
• Receptor proteins: cell membrane mein; chemical signals wusool karte hain.
• Regulatory proteins: cell aur jism ki activities control karte hain; misaal insulin sugar metabolism control karta hai; growth hormone.

book_ref.quote: Proteins can be grouped into different categories based on their biological and metabolic functions.

blocks.prompt:
12 What are enzymes? Explain the role of the active site in enzyme specificity and describe the lock and key model. (4 marks)
(Enzymes kya hain? Enzyme ki specificity mein active site ka kirdar samjhayein aur lock and key model bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Enzymes proteins hain jo zinda organisms ke chemical reactions ke liye biological catalysts hain. Yeh reaction ko itna tez karte hain jo un ke baghair namumkin ho; misaal carbonic anhydrase ka aik molecule aik second mein taqreeban das lakh CO₂ aur H₂O molecules ko carbonic acid banata hai.

Active site: enzyme ki satah par khaas jagah jo substrate ko bandhti aur products mein badalti hai.

Specificity: har enzyme aik khaas substrate par kaam karta hai kyun ke active site ki munfarid shakal mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai. Be-tarteeb harkat se substrate active site mein aata hai aur aarzi enzyme–substrate complex banta hai; phir products nikal jate hain aur enzyme waisa hi reh kar agle substrate se judta hai:
E + S → ES complex → E + products

Lock and key model (Emil Fischer, 1894): enzyme taala hai, substrate chaabi aur active site chaabi ka soorakh. Sirf sahi shakal ki chaabi (substrate) taale ke soorakh mein fit hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: An enzyme has a special site on its surface, called the active site

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein carbonic anhydrase ke liye 'one minute' chhapa hai; book correction ke mutabiq yeh 'one second' hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 One molecule of carbonic anhydrase converts about 10⁶ molecules of CO₂ (with water) to carbonic acid per second. (i) How many CO₂ molecules does one enzyme molecule convert in one hour? (ii) How many enzyme molecules are needed to convert 1.8 × 10¹⁰ CO₂ molecules in one second? (4 marks)
(Carbonic anhydrase ka aik molecule fi second taqreeban 10⁶ CO₂ molecules (paani ke saath) ko carbonic acid banata hai. (i) Aik enzyme molecule aik ghante mein kitne CO₂ molecules badlega? (ii) Aik second mein 1.8 × 10¹⁰ CO₂ molecules badalne ke liye kitne enzyme molecules chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Turnover ko seconds mein waqt se zarb dein; (ii) mein badalne wale molecules ko aik enzyme ke turnover se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: turnover about 10⁶ per second

steps: (ii) Aik enzyme molecule aik second mein 10⁶ molecules badalta hai

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the factors that affect the activity of enzymes. (4 marks)
(Enzymes ki activity par asar daalne wale factors bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ahem factors temperature, pH aur substrate o enzyme ki concentration hain; co-enzymes, activators aur inhibitors jaise substances bhi asar daalte hain.

Temperature aur pH: jis temperature aur pH par activity sab se ziyada ho woh optimum temperature aur pH hain. In se hatne par enzyme ka amal ruk sakta hai. Insani jism aur doosre organisms mein enzymatic reactions 37 °C ke qareeb behtareen hote hain.

Enzyme aur substrate ki concentration: concentration barhane se rate barhta hai kyun ke ziyada molecules se ziyada binding sites milti hain aur ziyada enzyme-substrate complex banta hai.

Doosre substances: co-enzymes aur activators enzyme ki madad karte hain, jab ke inhibitors enzyme ki activity khatam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The enzyme action may also be affected in the presence of some other substances

blocks.prompt:
15 What are enzyme inhibitors? Explain reversible (competitive) inhibition with the example of malonate, and irreversible inhibition with the example of penicillin. (4 marks)
(Enzyme inhibitors kya hain? Malonate ki misaal se reversible (competitive) inhibition aur penicillin ki misaal se irreversible inhibition samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Inhibitors chhote molecules ya ions hain jo enzymes ki catalytic activity khatam karte hain; sab active site ko substrate se judne se rokte hain.

Reversible (competitive) inhibitors: substrate jaisi shakal wale molecules; substrate aur inhibitor active site ke liye muqabla karte hain aur inhibitor non-covalent bonds se judta hai. Jitna ziyada inhibitor, utna enzyme substrate ke liye be-asar.
Misaal: succinate dehydrogenase butanedioate (succinate ion), ⁻OOC–CH₂–CH₂–COO⁻, ko oxidise karta hai. Propanedioate (malonate), ⁻OOC–CH₂–COO⁻, is jaisa hai aur enzyme ko rokta hai.

Irreversible inhibitors: chhote ions ya molecules jo active site ki shakal badal dete hain aur substrate ke liye jagah nahi rehti; enzyme hamesha ke liye be-asar ho jata hai. Yeh sehat ke sangeen masail ya maut ka sabab ban sakta hai. Zehar, antibiotics, anti-metabolites aur kuch dawaiyan aisa karti hain.
Misaal: penicillin trans-peptidase enzyme ko rokta hai jo bacteria ki cell wall banata hai, is tarah bacteria mar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: A variety of small molecules or ions that cause enzymes to lose their catalytic activity are called inhibitors.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book corrections: reversible inhibitor covalent nahi balke non-covalent bonds se judta hai; enzyme ka naam succinate dehydrogenase hai; bacteria ko penicillin maarta hai, insulin nahi.

blocks.prompt:
16 What are simple lipids? Describe triglycerides (fats and oils) and waxes, with their properties and uses. (4 marks)
(Simple lipids kya hain? Triglycerides (fats aur oils) aur waxes ko un ki khasusiyaat aur istemal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Simple lipids fatty acids aur mukhtalif alcohols ke esters hain; in ki qismein fats, oils aur waxes hain.

Triglycerides: janwaron ki fats aur sabzi ke oils aik glycerol molecule aur teen fatty acids (aik jaise ya mukhtalif) ke esters hain:
glycerol + 3 fatty acids → triglyceride + 3 H₂O
• Fats mein saturated fatty acids hain aur room temperature par solid hain; oils mein aik ya ziyada double bonds wale unsaturated fatty acids hain.
• Energy jama karne ke behtareen molecules; insulation, aaza ki hifazat aur fat mein hal vitamins ka zariya bhi.
• Hydrophobic fatty acid chains fats ko paani mein na-hal magar organic solvents mein hal banati hain, is liye yeh jild ke neeche insulating teh aur gurdon jaise aaza ke gird gadda banate hain.

Waxes: lambi fatty acid chains aur lambi chain wale alcohols ke esters; dono chains non-polar aur hydrophobic. Yeh hifazati teh banate hain jis par paani nahi chipakta, misaal beeswax (bara ester myricyl palmitate, CH₃(CH₂)₁₄COO(CH₂)₂₉CH₃), whale ke sar ka tel, kuch aabi parindon ke par, paudon ka wax. Lotions, ointments aur polishes mein istemal.

book_ref.quote: Simple lipids are sub-classified based on the type of alcohols

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ka chhapa hua beeswax ester (C₇₂) bohat lamba hai; book correction ke mutabiq bara ester myricyl palmitate hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 What are compound lipids? Describe the structure of phospholipids and the formation of a bilayer, and give the roles of lipoproteins, glycolipids and liposomes. (4 marks)
(Compound lipids kya hain? Phospholipids ki banawat aur bilayer ka banna bayan karein, aur lipoproteins, glycolipids aur liposomes ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Compound lipids fatty acids aur aise alcohols ke esters hain jin mein izaafi group ho, jaise phosphate, nitrogenous base, carbohydrate ya protein.

Phospholipids: fat jaisa magar glycerol par sirf do fatty acids; glycerol ka teesra –OH phosphate group se juda hai jo molecule ko polar banata hai. Hydrocarbon dumein hydrophobic hain, jab ke phosphate group aur us se jude hisse hydrophilic sir banate hain.

Bilayer: paani mein phospholipids do tehon wali sheet (bilayer) banate hain: polar sir bahar aur non-polar dumein andar apni teh mein ikatthi. Yahi tamam cell membranes ki banawat hai.

Lipoproteins: lipids aur proteins ke complexes jo hydrophobic lipids (cholesterol aur triglycerides) ko khoon mein le jate hain.
Glycolipids: lipids jin se carbohydrate groups jude hon, ziyada tar nervous tissue mein.
Liposomes: masnoi phospholipid dhanche, paani wale markaz ke gird lipid bilayer; yeh paani mein hal (misaal cancer ki) dawaiyan andar band kar ke tootne se bachate, solubility barhate aur seedha tumour cells tak pohanchate hain.

book_ref.quote: The hydrocarbon tails are hydrophobic

blocks.prompt:
18 What are derived lipids? Describe terpenes and carotenoids, and explain why steroids are grouped with lipids, naming the steroids found in living systems. (4 marks)
(Derived lipids kya hain? Terpenes aur carotenoids bayan karein, aur samjhayein ke steroids ko lipids ke saath kyun rakha jata hai, zinda nizaam ke steroids ke naam ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Derived (associated) lipids: simple aur compound lipids ki hydrolysis ke products jin mein lipid ki khasusiyaat hain, misaal fatty acids, glycerol, steroids aur lipid mein hal vitamins. Yeh khud fats nahi magar fats se bante hain, aur energy o hormones banane, cell ki banawat, nerves ki sehat aur vitamins ke kaam mein hissa lete hain.

Terpenes: paudon ke mukhtalif hydrocarbons (essential oils) jo isoprene units, CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂ (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene, C₅H₈), se bante hain. 40 carbon atoms wale terpenes carotenoids hain. Limonene terpene ki misaal hai.

Steroids: fatty acids se nahi bante magar un mein kuch lipid jaisi khasusiyaat hain, is liye lipids ke saath rakhe jate hain. Steroid nucleus teen cyclohexane rings aur aik cyclopentane ring ka jora hai jin ke naam A, B, C, D hain. Bohat se steroids mein –OH group hota hai jo inhein alcohol class (sterols) mein rakhta hai.
Biological steroids: cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D aur steroid hormones.

book_ref.quote: They perform important roles in the body including energy and hormone production

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ka chhapa hua isoprene formula ghalat hai; sahi CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂ hai (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the nutritional and biological importance of lipids. (4 marks)
(Lipids ki ghizai aur biological ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
• Energy ka zakheera: lipids ka bara kaam zinda organisms mein energy ka bunyaadi zakheera hona hai. Carbon dioxide aur paani tak oxidise hone par un ki caloric value ziyada hai, is liye yeh carbohydrates se fi gram ziyada energy dete hain.
• Fat mein hal vitamins: lipids vitamins A, D, E aur K ke liye solvent ka kaam karte aur unhein aanton ke cells aur phir khoon mein jazb karwate hain; yeh vitamins thodi sehatmand fat ke saath khane chahiye.
• Insulation: non-polar fitrat ki wajah se fats jism ko paani, garmi aur bijli se bachate hain; jild ke neeche teh aur aaza ke gird gadda bhi banate hain.
• Hibernation: polar bears, reptiles aur amphibians hibernation mein ziyada fat jama karte hain; fat glycogen se ziyada concentrated energy hai, is liye bohat kam metabolic rate mein jama fat behtar kaam aata hai.
• Doosre kaam (27.4): fuel molecules, signal molecules, membranes ke hisse, hormones aur cell ke andar paigham-rasaan.

book_ref.quote: Lipids act as solvents for the transport of fat vitamins

blocks.prompt:
20 What are nucleic acids? Describe how nucleotides join to form a polynucleotide chain, naming the sugars present and the linkage involved. (4 marks)
(Nucleic acids kya hain? Bayan karein ke nucleotides jud kar polynucleotide chain kaise banate hain, sugars aur linkage ke naam ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Nucleic acids bade biomolecules hain jo genetic maloomat jama aur muntaqil karte hain; yeh nucleotides naami chhote units ke polymers hain.

Banawat: nucleic acid nucleotides ki chain hai jis mein baari baari sugar aur phosphate groups hain aur sugar se organic (nitrogenous) bases jude hain.
Sugars: RNA mein ribose aur DNA mein deoxyribose; dono paanch carbon wali sugars hain.

Linkage: nucleotides sugar ke 5' aur 3' carbon atoms ke zariye phosphodiester linkages se judte hain; 3' O–P bond single hai aur P=O non-bridging oxygen par hai. Yeh kai million baar dohrane se polynucleotide banta hai.
…–sugar(3')–O–P(=O)(O⁻)–O–(5')sugar–…

Mazbooti: phosphodiester linkages mazboot covalent bonds hain jo polynucleotide chain ko mazbooti aur istehkaam dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Nucleic acids are formed from the nucleotide chains

blocks.prompt:
21 Describe the double helix structure of DNA proposed by Watson and Crick, including base pairing, and explain the importance of replication. (4 marks)
(Watson aur Crick ka pesh kiya hua DNA ka double helix structure base pairing samet bayan karein, aur replication ki ahmiyat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1953 mein James Watson aur Francis Crick ne dikhaya ke DNA do polynucleotide chains par mushtamil hai.

• Har chain right-handed helical spiral banati hai aur dono chains aik doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banati hain.
• Chains aik jaisi nahi balke base pairing ki wajah se ulat hain: aik ka 3' sira doosri ke 5' sire ke saamne hai.
• Har chain ka sugar-phosphate backbone hai; bases seedhe zaviye par bahar nikalte hain aur saamne wali chain ke bases se kamzor hydrogen bonds se jude hain.
• Base pairing: adenine (A) hamesha thymine (T) ke saamne, do hydrogen bonds; guanine (G) cytosine (C) ke saamne, teen hydrogen bonds.
• Chaar bases ki tarteeb genetic maloomat rakhti hai jo protein synthesis ke liye theek theek muntaqil hoti hai.

Replication: cell cycle ka woh process jis mein DNA ki naqal banti hai taake cell taqseem ho to har naye cell ko genetic material ka poora set mile. Is tarah genetic maloomat beti cells aur agli nasal tak pohanchti hai.

book_ref.quote: Each chain has a sugar-phosphate backbone

blocks.prompt:
22 Answer the following about DNA base pairing. (i) One strand of a DNA segment reads A-T-G-G-C-A-T-C-G-C. Write the complementary strand and find the total number of hydrogen bonds between the two strands. (ii) A DNA segment has 30 base pairs, of which 12 are G–C pairs. How many hydrogen bonds hold its strands together? (4 marks)
(DNA base pairing ke baare mein jawab dein. (i) DNA ke aik strand par A-T-G-G-C-A-T-C-G-C hai. Complementary strand likhein aur dono strands ke darmiyan kul hydrogen bonds maloom karein. (ii) Aik DNA segment mein 30 base pairs hain jin mein 12 G–C pairs hain. Is ke strands ko kitne hydrogen bonds jodte hain?)
blocks.explanation: A ka jora T aur G ka C; A–T jode × 2 aur G–C jode × 3 ginein.

book_ref.quote: There are two hydrogen bonds between A and T pair

steps: A–T jode (A, T, A, T) = 4 → 4 × 2 = 8; G–C jode (G, G, C, C, G, C) = 6 → 6 × 3 = 18; kul = 26

blocks.prompt:
24 What is a gene? Explain how the instructions of a gene are converted into a protein molecule, stating where each step takes place. (4 marks)
(Gene kya hai? Samjhayein ke gene ki hidayaat protein molecule mein kaise badalti hain, aur har step kahan hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Gene: DNA ka khaas hissa jo genetic maloomat rakhta aur cell ko khaas protein banane ki hidayat deta hai.

Protein synthesis ke liye do processes chahiye: transcription aur translation.

Transcription (nucleus mein): protein banane ki genetic hidayaat DNA gene se messenger RNA (mRNA) mein naqal hoti hain. mRNA strand mukammal ho kar DNA se alag hota aur cytoplasm mein jata hai.

Translation (cytoplasm mein ribosomes par): mRNA ribosomes (jo rRNA ki madad se bante hain) se judta hai. mRNA ka code parh kar amino acids ki khaas tarteeb banai jati hai; tRNA mRNA ki nucleotide tarteeb ko mutabiq amino acids mein tarjuma karta hai. tRNA molecules apne amino acids chhodte hain jo polypeptide chain mein judte hain; amino acids ke darmiyan bonds banne se chain barhti hai aur aakhir mukammal protein banta hai.

DNA gene → (transcription) → mRNA → (ribosome par translation) → protein

book_ref.quote: Two processes, transcription and translation are required

blocks.prompt:
25 What are minerals? Classify them into macro- and micro-minerals with examples, and describe the roles of calcium, phosphorus and zinc in nutrition. (4 marks)
(Minerals kya hain? Unhein misaalon ke saath macro aur micro minerals mein taqseem karein, aur ghiza mein calcium, phosphorus aur zinc ke kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Minerals inorganic substances hain jo zindagi ke kuch physiochemical processes ke liye zaroori hain. Yeh energy nahi dete magar mukhtalif activities mein ahem kaam karte hain.

Darja bandi:
• Macro (major) minerals, rozana taqreeban 100 mg se ziyada chahiye: calcium, phosphorus, sodium, chloride, potassium, magnesium aur sulfur.
• Micro (trace) minerals, rozana taqreeban 100 mg se kam chahiye: iron, copper, cobalt, iodine, zinc, manganese, molybdenum, fluoride, chromium aur selenium.

Kirdar (Table 27.1):
• Calcium (doodh aur dairy, hari sabziyan, broccoli, salmon, sardines, phaliyan): haddiyan aur daant banana, khoon ka theek jamna, muscles ka sukadna aur phailna, dil aur nerves ka kaam.
• Phosphorus (gosht, machhli, murghi, anday, doodh, anaaj): haddiyan aur daant banana; jism ki energy (ATP) ka nikalna aur istemal control karna; phospholipids ka hissa ban kar fat le jana; acid/base tawazun theek rakhna.
• Zinc (gosht, samandari khurak, saabut anaaj): bohat se enzyme systems ka hissa (growth, immune function); insulin hormone mein paya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Minerals are inorganic substances, necessary for the maintenance of certain physiochemical life processes

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: potassium, magnesium aur sulfur macro-minerals hain, aur had taqreeban 100 mg rozana hai (mg/dL khoon ki concentration hai, zaroori miqdaar nahi).
